question: Do independently frozen Mark results fit a typed construction grammar better than a flat shape-feature model, with distinct evidence behavior for edge scaffold, junction/vertex, boundary/cycle, relation, degree, state/program, and realization/style layers?
importantStatus: This is a retrospective synthesis of experiments whose source outcomes already exist. The type map and adjudication rules are frozen before the synthesis script runs, but this is not a prospective confirmation of the underlying source data.

role_preservation.note: Topology v3, critical-center edit v4, and matched-edge geometry v6 share ancestry and must be treated as one evidence lineage rather than three independent replications.

white_paint_transfer.note: Standardized proxy v2 and physical museum-witness v3 form one cross-representation lineage; physical v3 has a known local-tile unit mismatch and is not treated as isolated-glyph evidence.

state_program.note: The state-transition grammar is a separate higher-order analysis over frozen anonymous nested regions. It is not counted as independent historical semantics.

typeMap.EDGE_SCAFFOLD: connection existence/adjacency/multiplicity between critical structures; represented here by transferred junction-to-junction arm-rate constraint
typeMap.JUNCTION_VERTEX: critical centers, endpoint/junction inventory, degrees, and junction-local arm-class edits
typeMap.BOUNDARY_CYCLE: literal enclosure/open-vs-closed relation of a carrier; expected to be carrier/unit sensitive
typeMap.RELATION: attachment position between an identified modifier/junction and carrier terminal/interior; expected to require carrier segmentation
typeMap.DEGREE: ordered multiplicity/repetition of equivalent structural units
typeMap.STATE_PROGRAM: ordered transition and persistence constraints over nested physical states
typeMap.REALIZATION_GEOMETRY: residual turn/tortuosity after scaffold is matched; comparator layer rather than presumed protected grammar
typeMap.STYLE_REALIZATION: surface/appearance features that may carry system identity without being the structural instruction set

P1_TYPED_SEPARATION.prediction: The evidence will not behave like one flat shape-feature layer: scaffold/junction, degree, and state/program evidence will remain supported while residual path geometry is unprotected and boundary/relation evidence shows unit dependence.
P1_TYPED_SEPARATION.gate: P2, P3, and P6 pass; at least one of P4/P5 passes; REALIZATION_GEOMETRY is demoted by P2.

P2_SCAFFOLD_OVER_RESIDUAL_GEOMETRY.prediction: Role preservation constrains graph scaffold and critical vertices more strongly than detailed residual path shape once structure is matched.
P2_SCAFFOLD_OVER_RESIDUAL_GEOMETRY.gate: The topology junction-to-junction arm-rate atom has same-direction transfer in all lanes; critical-center insertion/deletion is a strong-transfer atom with positive effect in all lanes; both train and holdout turn-rate/tortuosity matched effects have absolute magnitude <0.08.

P3_DEGREE_CROSS_REPRESENTATION.prediction: Degree/multiplicity behaves as a robust operator across isolated standardized glyphs and physical witness surfaces.
P3_DEGREE_CROSS_REPRESENTATION.gate: Proxy repetition prediction passes and physical repetition prediction passes under their frozen source protocols.

P4_BOUNDARY_IS_CARRIER_RELATIVE.prediction: Closure is a meaningful structural distinction only relative to the correct carrier/unit, so isolated-glyph closure should be diverse while coarse physical patches should collapse toward artificial closure.
P4_BOUNDARY_IS_CARRIER_RELATIVE.gate: Proxy closure prediction passes; proxy closed share is between 0.10 and 0.70; physical closed share exceeds 0.95; physical closure prediction fails.

P5_RELATION_REQUIRES_CARRIER_SEGMENTATIO.prediction: Attachment relation is not a free-standing shape property; it requires identified carrier/modifier units and should collapse under coarse multi-mark physical patches.
P5_RELATION_REQUIRES_CARRIER_SEGMENTATIO.gate: Proxy has both near-terminal and interior relation classes with interior >=10% of relation-eligible glyphs and support in >=8 script systems; physical interior relation share is <1% while near-terminal exceeds 95%.

P6_STATE_PROGRAM_IS_HIGHER_ORDER.prediction: Ordered state programs form a higher-order grammar layer distinct from local shape, with strong directional constraints across all three lanes.
P6_STATE_PROGRAM_IS_HIGHER_ORDER.gate: >=75% of all nine edges and >=75% of all 27 programs are both beyond all primary nulls and same-direction across train/holdout/control; observed commitment:return ratio is >=5x the null mean ratio.

P7_STYLE_AND_STRUCTURE_DIVIDE_LABOR.prediction: System identity is carried more strongly by appearance than by white-paint structure, and that separation should remain in physical witnesses.
P7_STYLE_AND_STRUCTURE_DIVIDE_LABOR.gate: Both proxy and physical substrate-vs-style predictions pass, and the physical appearance advantage is greater than the proxy appearance advantage.

adjudication.typedGrammarSupportedAsWorkingArchitectu: P1, P2, P3, P6, and P7 pass. P4/P5 are allowed to be unit-sensitive rather than universal; their role is to classify boundary/relation as carrier-dependent types.
adjudication.flatShapeModelRejected: P2 passes: protected structural scaffold/vertex behavior coexists with collapsed residual geometry after matching.

allowed: the already-frozen experiments exhibit evidence signatures consistent or inconsistent with a typed construction-grammar architecture
some feature classes can be demoted, promoted, or marked carrier-dependent for future Mark and Atlas tests
the synthesis can generate a concrete instruction-set hypothesis for prospective testing
forbidden: Atlas meanings are present in ancient signs
the three source lineages are statistically independent replications
physical v3 patch closure or attachment is valid isolated-glyph measurement
retrospective synthesis thresholds are prospective confirmation of source outcomes
